motivation: The observable top-degree deficit normalization in H4ar reduced recovery to98/256. Test whether an exact correction derived from supplied corruption-location masks performs better than raw counts. This is a privileged-information diagnostic of the normalization mechanism, not a deployable estimator or an information-theoretic bound.
scope: All256 examined H4an600-row banks, same observed noisy equality counts and original inferred degrees. Supply the archived per-row corruption-location masks as additional privileged supervision. No clean values, actual digit offsets, graph geometry, true degree or truth graph enter score construction. No new source draws, observed labels, noise or puzzle solves.
channel_identity: Let m_ri indicate whether cell i was corrupted in row r, and b_ri=1-9*m_ri/8. Under the specified independent uniform nonzero digit offsets, conditional on fixed clean digits and corruption masks, E[9*1(Y_ri=Y_rj)-1] = b_ri*b_rj*(9*1(X_ri=X_rj)-1). This identity allows arbitrarily dependent cell-selection masks; it uses independent offset channels after the mask is fixed. For a true exclusion edge, clean values differ on every row, giving E[9*c_ij-N | clean,masks] = -sum_r b_ri*b_rj. The rounded corrected score below has conditional expectation within0.5 of -1000000 for a true edge when its denominator is positive. This does not establish low variance or correct graph recovery.

estimator.mask: Read only archived cells[:600], the nine corrupted cell indices per row, from each hash-pinned parent source archive. Encode m as a600x81 Boolean matrix. Actual clean values and offsets remain inaccessible to the scoring interface.
estimator.attenuation: W_ij = sum_r (8-9*m_ri)*(8-9*m_rj), an exact integer. This retains empirical joint corruption frequencies rather than replacing them with products of marginal rates.
estimator.cost: If every pair has W_ij>0, use cost_ij = round-half-even(64000000*(9*c_ij-600)/W_ij), with exact signed integer numerator/denominator arithmetic. Retain negative costs. If any W is nonpositive, retain the whole bank as unresolved and skip its LP; no clamping, dropping pairs, or changing the transform.
estimator.fit: One exact common-degree LP at the original inferred d, unchanged literal scale-two primal/dual certificate rules. Certified fractional optima count as resolved graph failures; uncertified results unresolved. No score tuning or graph-primal rounding.
estimator.bound: For positive integer W>=1, costs lie between -38400000000 and307200000000, requiring int64 but remaining within the existing certificate range. Complete objectives for these degrees remain exactly representable as binary64 integers. Solver numerical failures remain unresolved.

endpoints.recovery: At least145/256 exact graphs, versus fixed raw-count baseline129/256. Lower=exact, upper=exact+unresolved; support if lower>=145, falsify if upper<145, otherwise inconclusive.
endpoints.paired_loss: At most8 lost baseline successes. Lower=resolved failures among baseline successes; upper adds unresolved baseline successes. Support if upper<=8, falsify if lower>8, otherwise inconclusive.

supervision_accounting: All256*600*9=1382400 archived corruption-location indices are newly supplied to this estimator, determining12441600 mask entries. They are privileged noise metadata, not free ordinary observations or new official label queries. Compare raw-count and normalized-deficit outputs only with this scope difference explicit. BP AdamW is not rerun in this source-only diagnostic.
gates: Before freeze: exhaustively enumerate nine-symbol channel offsets for equal/unequal clean pairs and all four corruption-mask states; independently verify the conditional identity; exact half-even boundary/range tests; independent mask-index reconstruction and pair-product sums on unrelated fixtures; negative/nonpositive denominator unresolved tests; selected-degree certificate and endpoint-boundary gates; seed registry. Freeze source hashes and source-archive hashes before inspecting study masks or computing attenuation scores.
independent_audit: Verify each supplied mask against independently regenerated archived noise-selection streams, hash-bind original archives, and independently recompute exact W, numerators, denominators and rounded scores. Count provenance remains inherited from H4an. Recheck all available new proofs and all256 baseline proofs, reject three mutations per valid certificate, and reconstruct true graphs only for post-fit evaluation. Preserve all masks, costs, fractional outputs and unresolved banks in the public export.
budget_scope: Source hash verification, mask extraction, attenuation construction, new LPs, independent bank audits and export. Synthetic preflight and subsequent publication replays separate. Whole-run budget or provenance failures make the study incomplete, never a reduced-cohort result.
interpretation: A gain would show utility of this supplied mask correction on the examined cohort, not that corruption masks can be learned from observations. Failure would reject this fixed correction even with masks; it would not prove that corruption knowledge cannot help through another estimator. No oracle-optimality, universal upper bound, fresh generalization or puzzle-solving claim.
